column1: # Packages the Field Notebook rice needs, read by omarchy/setup.sh (packages
# step). They live here, not in install/pacmanfile, because only this rice on
# an Omarchy desktop uses them, and several are AUR-only.
# Columns (tab- or space-separated):
#   name     the package name
#   source   repo (official Arch repos, `omarchy pkg add`) or aur (`omarchy pkg aur add`)
#   why      what in the rice uses it
spotify-player          repo    now-playing pane (fn-session) and its theme
spotify-launcher        repo    the Spotify client fn-session starts
cava                    repo    visualizer pane, themed by share/themed.py
fastfetch               repo    dashboard plate (fn-dashboard)
onefetch                repo    terminal extra installed with the rice
tokei                   repo    terminal extra installed with the rice
imagemagick             repo    share/make-wallpapers.sh
ttf-ibmplex-mono-nerd   repo    BlexMono, the rice's terminal and label font
vesktop-bin             aur     Discord client; its settings carry the rice
ttf-fraunces            aur     lscaturchio.xyz display typeface
ttf-instrument-sans     aur     lscaturchio.xyz text typeface
cbonsai                 aur     terminal extra installed with the rice
gh-dash-bin             aur     GitHub pane (fn-session)
